summary_en: This study tests belumosudil mesylate, given alone and with dexamethasone, in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. Belumosudil mesylate is taken by mouth; how long or how often it is given is not stated. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 1/Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa belumosudil mesilato, administrado solo y con dexametasona, en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario. El belumosudil mesilato se toma por vía oral; la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica; este es un estudio de Fase 1/Fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with symptomatic multiple myeloma.
Measurable disease, as defined in the record.
Relapsed or refractory disease after at least 3 prior lines, including triple-class refractory disease.
ECOG performance status 0, 1, or 2, or 3 due to disease burden or symptoms.
Adequate blood counts, liver, heart, and kidney function as defined in the record.
not_for: Currently receiving another investigational agent with known or suspected activity against myeloma.
Known allergy to compounds similar to belumosudil mesylate.
Known clinically active hepatitis A, B, or C infection, with listed exceptions.
Uncontrolled illness not related to myeloma, in the opinion of the Principal Investigator.
